'''Echur Varadadesikan Sampathkumaran''' (born 6 December 1954) is an Indian [[Condensed matter physics|condensed matter physicist]] and a distinguished professor at the [[Tata Institute of Fundamental Research]]. Known for his research on the thermal and transport behaviour of magnetic systems, Sampathkumaran is an elected fellow of major Indian science academies viz. [[Indian Academy of Sciences]], [[Indian National Science Academy]], [[National Academy of Sciences, India]] and [[The World Academy of Sciences]]. The [[Council of Scientific and Industrial Research]], the apex agency of the Government of India for scientific research, awarded him the [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science and Technology]], one of the highest Indian science awards, for his contributions to physical sciences in 1999.<ref name="View Bhatnagar Awardees">{{Cite web |url=http://ssbprize.gov.in/Content/AwardeeList.aspx |title=View Bhatnagar Awardees |date=2017-11-11 |publisher=Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize |access-date=2017-11-11}}</ref>{{Refn|group=note|Long link - please select award year to see details}}

== Biography ==
E. V. Sampathkumaran, born on 6 December 1954 in the south Indian state of [[Tamil Nadu]], earned his BSc degree from the [[University of Madras]] before obtaining a master's degree from [[Annamalai University]].<ref name="Indian fellow">{{Cite web |url=http://insaindia.res.in/detail/P02-1322 |title=Indian fellow |date=2017-10-17 |publisher=Indian National Science Academy |access-date=2017-10-17 |archive-date=19 October 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171019004028/http://insaindia.res.in/detail/P02-1322 }}</ref> Subsequently, he joined [[Tata Institute of Fundamental Research]] as a member of faculty in 1976.<ref name="Biographical Information">{{Cite web |url=http://www.tifr.res.in/~sampath/cv_evs_oct2016.pdf |title=Biographical Information |date=2017-10-18 |website=Tata Institute of Fundamental Research |access-date=2017-10-18}}</ref> During this period, he enrolled at the [[University of Mumbai]] for doctoral studies on ''valence fluctuations in rare-earth compounds'' and secured a PhD in 1982, guided by [[Ramanuja Vijayaraghavan]], a [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science and Technology|Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar laureate]]. He did his post-doctoral work on ''valence fluctuations'' as an [[Alexander von Humboldt Fellow]] at the [[Free University of Berlin]], under the guidance of G. Kaindl, during 1983–84 and returned to TIFR to resume his career there. Barring two sabbaticals, the first as an Indo-Waseda Exchange Visitor for two months in 1988 to Japan and the other, a two-month stint at [[Paderborn University]] in 1996, his entire career was spent at TIFR, holding various positions. During 2008–10, he chaired the Department of Condensed Matter Physics and Materials Science after which he served as the dean of the Natural Sciences faculty from 2010 to 2013. After his superannuation in 2014, he continues his association with the institute as a distinguished professor.<ref name="Distinguished Professor">{{Cite web |url=http://www.tifr.res.in/~sampath/ |title=Distinguished Professor |date=2017-10-18 |website=Tata Institute of Fundamental Research |access-date=2017-10-18}}</ref> He also had a brief stint as the director of the institute during April–July 2015<ref name="TIFR council to name new director soon">{{Cite web |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/City/Mumbai/TIFR-council-to-name-new-director-soon/articleshow/46800206.cms |title=TIFR council to name new director soon |date=2017-10-18 |website=Times of India |access-date=2017-10-18}}</ref> and served as an honorary professor at [[Jawaharlal Nehru Centre for Advanced Scientific Research]] from 2001 to 2015.<ref name="Biographical Information" />

== Legacy ==
[[File:Animation expliquant la courbe montrant la decouverte de la magnetoresistance géante.ogv|thumb|235px|Animation about the magnetoresistance discovery Graphs]]
Sampathkumaran's early research was focused on intermetallics and oxides, with regard to their solid state properties and his work led to the identification of new ''fluctuating-valent rare-earth systems''.<ref name="Indian fellow" /> The thermal and transport behaviour of magnetic systems,<ref name="Brief Profile of the Awardee">{{Cite web |url=http://ssbprize.gov.in/Content/Detail.aspx?AID=30 |title=Brief Profile of the Awardee |date=2017-10-17 |publisher=Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize |access-date=2017-10-17}}</ref><ref name="Handbook of Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize Winners">{{Cite web |url=http://www.csirhrdg.res.in/ssb.pdf |title=Handbook of Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize Winners |date=2017-10-17 |publisher=Council of Scientific and Industrial Research |access-date=2017-10-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304043957/http://www.csirhrdg.res.in/ssb.pdf |archive-date=4 March 2016 }}</ref> [[superconductivity]], physics of d- and f-electron systems, [[Kondo effect|Kondo lattices]], geometrically frustrated magnetism, spin-chain magnetism, [[multiferroics]] and [[nanomagnetism]] have been some of the other areas of his work.<ref name="Distinguished Professor" /> His studies have been documented by way of a number of articles<ref name="On Google Scholar">{{Cite web |url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=ieNy0l4AAAAJ&hl=en |title=On Google Scholar |date=2017-10-17 |publisher=Google Scholar |access-date=2017-10-17}}</ref><ref name="On ResearchGate">{{Cite web |url=https://www.researchgate.net/scientific-contributions/7905437_E_V_Sampathkumaran |title=On ResearchGate |date=2017-10-17 |access-date=2017-10-17}}</ref>{{Refn|group=note|Please see ''Selected bibliography'' section}} and the online article repository of the Indian Academy of Sciences has listed 302 of them.<ref name="Browse by Fellow">{{Cite web |url=http://repository.ias.ac.in/view/fellows/Sampathkumaran=3AEchur_Varadadesikan=3A=3A.html |title=Browse by Fellow |date=2017-10-17 |publisher=Indian Academy of Sciences |access-date=2017-10-17}}</ref>

Sampathkumaran is a member of the editorial boards of [[Solid State Communications]]<ref name="Solid State Communications Editorial Board">{{Cite web |url=https://www.journals.elsevier.com/solid-state-communications/editorial-board |title=Solid State Communications Editorial Board |date=2017-10-18 |website=Elsevier |access-date=2017-10-18}}</ref> and [[Journal of Magnetism and Magnetic Materials]]<ref name="Journal of Magnetism and Magnetic Materials Editorial Board">{{Cite web |url=https://www.journals.elsevier.com/journal-of-magnetism-and-magnetic-materials/editorial-board |title=Journal of Magnetism and Magnetic Materials Editorial Board |date=2017-10-18 |website=Elsevier |access-date=2017-10-18}}</ref> of [[Elsevier]] and [[Scientific Reports]] journal of [[Nature (journal)|Nature]].<ref name="Scientific Reports">{{Cite web |url=https://www.nature.com/srep/about/editorial-board#condensedmatterphysics |title=Scientific Reports |date=2017-10-18 |website=Nature |access-date=2017-10-18}}</ref> He is a former editorial board member of [[Pramana (journal)|Pramana journal]] (1996–2010) and the now discontinued ''The Open Condensed Matter Physics Journal'' of [[Bentham Science Publishers]]. He is a former member of Asia-Pacific Academy of Materials and sat in the executive committee of the Indian Physics Association from 2014 to 2016.<ref name="Executive Committees of IPA">{{Cite web |url=http://www.ipa1970.org.in/pastexlist.php |title=Executive Committees of IPA |date=2017-10-18 |website=Indian Physics Association |access-date=2017-10-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170411060234/http://www.ipa1970.org.in/pastexlist.php |archive-date=11 April 2017 }}</ref> His association with government agencies included membership in two committees of the [[Department of Science and Technology (India)|Department of Science and Technology]], namely the program advisory committee on Condensed Matter Physics (1995–98) and the committee for [[Science and Engineering Research Board|SERC]] Schools in Condensed Matter Physics (1998–). He is also a former member of the governing councils or management boards of [[Indian Association for the Cultivation of Science]] (2010–2011), [[National Physical Laboratory of India|National Physical Laboratory]] (2010–2012)
[[Raja Ramanna Centre for Advanced Technology]] (2010–2013) and TIFR Centre for Interdisciplinary Sciences at Hyderabad and the selection committees of Indian National Science Academy (2012–2014) and Indian Academy of Sciences (2013—2015).<ref name="Biographical Information" />

== Awards and honors ==
The [[Indian National Science Academy]] awarded Sampathkumaran the INSA Young Scientists Medal in 1986<ref name="INSA Young Scientists Medal">{{Cite web |url=http://insaindia.res.in/youngmedal.php |title=INSA Young Scientists Medal |date=2017-10-17 |publisher=Indian National Science Academy |access-date=2017-10-17 |archive-date=11 May 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210511084357/https://www.insaindia.res.in/youngmedal.php }}</ref> and a decade later, he received the MRSI Medal of the Materials Research Society of India in 1996.<ref name="MRSI Awards and Honours">{{Cite web |url=http://www.mrsi.org.in/awardshonours.php |title=MRSI Awards and Honours |date=2017-10-18 |website=Materials Research Society of India |access-date=2017-10-18}}</ref> The Council of Scientific and Industrial Research awarded him the [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize]], one of the highest Indian science awards in 1999.<ref name="CSIR list of Awardees">{{Cite web |url=http://www.csir.res.in/careeraward/prize-winner-indexdiscipline-wise |title=CSIR list of Awardees |date=2017 |publisher=Council of Scientific and Industrial Research}}</ref>

The [[Indian Academy of Sciences]] was the first Indian academy to honor him with an elected membership which he received in 1998.<ref name="Fellow profile">{{Cite web |url=http://www.ias.ac.in/describe/fellow/Sampathkumaran,_Prof._Echur_Varadadesikan |title=Fellow profile |date=2017-10-17 |publisher=Indian Academy of Sciences |access-date=2017-10-17}}</ref> The other two major academies followed suit, the elected fellowship of the [[National Academy of Sciences, India]] reaching him in 1999<ref name="NASI fellows">{{Cite web |url=http://www.nasi.org.in/fellows.asp?RsFilter=S |title=NASI fellows |date=2017 |publisher=National Academy of Sciences, India |access-date=18 October 2017 |archive-date=16 March 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160316043224/http://nasi.org.in/fellows.asp?RsFilter=S }}</ref> and that of the Indian National Science Academy in 2001.<ref name="INSA Year Book 2016">{{Cite web |url=http://www.insaindia.res.in/pdf/YearBook_2016.pdf |title=INSA Year Book 2016 |date=2017 |publisher=Indian National Science Academy |access-date=18 October 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161104001952/http://www.insaindia.res.in/pdf/YearBook_2016.pdf |archive-date=4 November 2016 }}</ref> He received the fellowship of [[The World Academy of Sciences]] in 2012.<ref name="TWAS fellow">{{Cite web |url=https://twas.org/member/sampathkumaran-echur-varadadesikan |title=TWAS fellow |date=2017-10-17 |publisher=The World Academy of Sciences |access-date=2017-10-17 |archive-date=19 October 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171019003634/https://twas.org/member/sampathkumaran-echur-varadadesikan }}</ref> He is also a recipient of the 2008 J. C. Bose National Fellowship of the [[Department of Science and Technology (India)|Department of Science and Technology]].<ref name="Biographical Information" />
